section.content: 本发明公开了一种应用于锂‑二硫化硒电池的双涂层隔膜及其制备方法和应用，属于新材料的技术领域。制备方法包括如下步骤：1）取1,3,6,8‑四(4‑甲醛基苯基)苝、对苯二胺以及二氧六环、乙酸溶液进行反应制得PA‑COF，为涂层A的原料；2）将步骤1）制得的PA‑COF、水系粘结剂以及正丙醇水充分混匀得浆料A；3）取TiO2、导电炭黑、水系粘结剂以及正丙醇水溶液充分混合均匀得浆料B；4）取浆料A和浆料B分别涂覆于电池隔膜的两侧，干燥，剪裁成圆片即得双涂层隔膜。其双涂层隔膜应用于面载量为2mg/cm2的锂‑二硫化硒电池中，通过TiO2的化学吸附作用有效地抑制穿梭效应的产生和共价有机框架对锂负极的保护作用从而避免锂枝晶的产生，有效提高电池的循环稳定性和电池的比容量。

The invention discloses a double-coating diaphragm applied to a lithium-selenium disulfide battery and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of new materials. The preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) taking 1,3,6, 8-tetra (4-formaldehyde phenyl) perylene, p-phenylenediamine, dioxane and acetic acid solution to react to prepare PA-COF which is a raw material of the coating A; 2) fully and uniformly mixing the PA-COF prepared in the step 1), the water-based binder and the n-propanol water to obtain slurry A; 3) taking TiO2The conductive carbon black, the water-based binder and the n-propanol aqueous solution are fully and uniformly mixed to obtain slurry B; 4) and coating the slurry A and the slurry B on two sides of the battery diaphragm respectively, drying, and cutting into wafers to obtain the double-coating diaphragm. The surface loading capacity of the double-coating diaphragm applied to the surface is 2mg/cm2In a lithium-selenium sulphide cell, by TiO2The chemical adsorption effect of the organic covalent compound can effectively inhibit the generation of shuttle effect and the protection effect of the organic covalent compound on the lithium negative electrode, thereby avoiding the generation of lithium dendrite and effectively improving the cycling stability of the battery and the specific capacity of the battery.

Double-coating diaphragm applied to lithium-selenium disulfide battery and preparation method and application thereofTechnical Field

The invention belongs to the technical field of new materials, and particularly relates to a double-coating diaphragm applied to a lithium-selenium disulfide battery, and a preparation method and application thereof.

Background

The global environmental pollution and energy crisis are getting worse, and the problems of huge environmental pollution and greenhouse effect are more and more prominent, so that the human beings urgently need to develop new green renewable energy sources to replace the current energy supply system. Which comprises the following steps: develop and design more environment-friendly electric vehicles and hybrid electric vehicles to realize CO2Zero or small emissions; energetically developing new renewable energy sources, such as wind, solar and tidal energyAnd the like. The development of these fields requires efficient energy storage systems, and lithium ion secondary batteries have many advantages such as high voltage, long cycle life, high specific energy at wide temperature, high safety and wide working range. An electrochemical energy storage system represented by a battery and a super capacitor not only can effectively store and transmit energy sources in the aspects of a power generation system and a power supply network, but also can effectively utilize electric energy and make up for the difference between supply and demand. In addition, lithium ion secondary batteries are the main energy supply devices for almost all portable mobile electronic devices such as mobile phones and notebook computers at present, and the performance and cost of the energy supply devices seriously affect the service performance, portability, durability and appearance of the electronic devices and also affect the market and commercial value of the electronic devices.

However, the performance of the existing lithium ion secondary battery is far from meeting the market requirements for power supply, transportation and portable energy storage, for example, in order to enable an electric vehicle or a hybrid vehicle to completely replace the existing gasoline-powered vehicle, a new energy storage system with higher specific energy and better cycle life is required. The requirements of new generation electronic information products on energy storage systems are higher and higher, the current designs are developed towards the trend of light weight, thinness, shortness and smallness, and the power supply becomes a difficult problem to be solved urgently. Many countries, such as japan, usa and europe, have invested a lot of manpower and material resources to develop lithium ion batteries, so that the specific energy available for the existing cathode materials is greatly improved, but the technical requirements for rapid growth and development cannot be met, and thus, the development of new materials and chemical systems is urgently needed.

Metal-chalcogenide batteries have attracted much attention in recent years due to their high theoretical energy density, low cost, and environmental friendliness. Among the numerous metal-chalcogenide batteries, the lithium-sulfur battery is the most well studied, in which the S8 molecule is first broken to form Li during discharge2Sn(n.gtoreq.4), then Li2Sn(n is not less than 4) further reacting to generate Li2And S. Therefore, the lithium-sulfur battery has a battery capacity of 3467 mA h cm-3Volume specific capacity of 1675The theoretical specific capacity of mA.h.g < -1 > is about five times that of the lithium ion battery, and the lithium-selenium battery has the same reaction mechanism, so the lithium-selenium battery has 3253 mA.h.cm < --3The sum of the volume specific capacity of 678 mA · h · g-1Theoretical specific mass capacity of (2). Similar to the positive electrode of sulfur and selenium, the selenium disulfide has good conductivity and moderate theoretical specific capacity (1125 mA.h.g)-1) And integrates various advantages of the sulfur and selenium anode. Therefore, the sulfur and selenium positive electrode is expected to be used as a positive electrode material of the lithium chalcogenide battery instead of the sulfur and selenium positive electrode, but the sulfur and selenium positive electrode is all chalcogen elements, so that the shuttle effect is inevitably suffered. It is therefore the main work of the present investigators to address the shuttling effect. But the lithium-selenium disulfide battery applied at present is based on a positive electrode material. Most importantly, inhibition of polysulfide and polyselenide shuttling by the porous carrier material comes at the expense of energy density, since the porous carrier does not provide any capacity. Typically, up to 30-60% by weight of the support material is required to effectively suppress the shuttling effect of polysulfides and polyselenides in the positive electrode, which means that energy losses of about 20-50% are obtained compared to a 70% mass fraction pure sulfur/carbon black cathode, which results in a low loading of active material, most not more than 2mg cm-2Limiting the practical application of lithium-selenium disulfide batteries.

Meanwhile, since Yaghi and coworkers reported the first example of COFs materials in 2005, COFs materials have been rapidly developed and are now widely used in the fields of gas storage and separation, catalysis, photoelectric devices, energy storage and the like.

Disclosure of Invention

In view of the above, the problems in the development and application of the lithium-selenium disulfide battery in the prior art, and the problems in the shuttle effect of the lithium-selenium disulfide battery and the low surface loading of active materials based on the positive electrode material, the present invention is to provide a double-coated separator applied to the lithium-selenium disulfide battery, and a preparation method and an application thereof.

The technical scheme of the invention is as follows:

double-coating applied to lithium-selenium disulfide batteryThe membrane comprises a coating layer containing a covalent organic framework PA-COF (TFPY-PA-COF, hereinafter referred to as PA-COF), a battery membrane and a membrane layer containing TiO2Coating of (2).

The invention also provides a preparation method of the double-coating diaphragm applied to the lithium-selenium disulfide battery, which comprises the following steps:

1) preparation of raw materials of slurry a: taking 1,3,6, 8-tetra (4-formaldehyde phenyl) perylene (abbreviated as TFPY in English, purchased from Zhengzhou alpha chemical Co., Ltd., CAS number: 1415238-25-3), p-phenylenediamine, dioxane and acetic acid solution to react to prepare PA-COF, wherein the synthesized porous covalent organic framework PA-COF is a raw material of a coating A;

2) preparation of slurry A: fully and uniformly mixing the PA-COF prepared in the step 1), a water-based binder and n-propanol water to obtain a slurry A (slurry is prepared by mixing the PA-COF and the binder);

3) preparation of slurry B: taking TiO2The conductive carbon black, the water-based binder and the n-propanol aqueous solution are fully and uniformly mixed to obtain slurry B (slurry is prepared by mixing carbon dioxide and the binder);

4) preparing a double-coating diaphragm: coating the slurry A and the slurry B on two sides of the battery diaphragm respectively, drying, and cutting into wafers to obtain the double-coating diaphragm; the two sides of the diaphragm are respectively coated with functional materials, so that the two sides of the diaphragm have different functions, the side facing the negative electrode is used for inhibiting the growth of lithium dendrites, and the side facing the positive electrode is used for inhibiting the shuttle of polysulfide/selenium ions.

Wherein, the reaction in the step 1) is carried out in an argon environment in a sealing way, and washing is carried out after the reaction is finished;

the washed reagent solution comprises 1, 4-dioxane, tetrahydrofuran and acetone, a target product is obtained by synthesis in an inert atmosphere, and unreacted impurities are washed away by washing

Further, in the step 1), the adding amount of acetic acid is 5% -50% of the total volume of the organic solvent, the acetic acid is added as a catalyst, and the target product is prepared by adjusting the amount of the catalyst

Fully mixing the PA-COF and the water-based binder, and then dropwise adding an n-propanol aqueous solution; the PA-COF and the water-based binder are used in a ratio of (3-5): 1, the water-based binder comprises LA132 water-based binder; the coating effect is improved through the change of the coating process;

the operation of step 3) is to first TiO2Fully mixing the conductive carbon black and the water-based binder, and then dropwise adding an n-propanol aqueous solution; the coating effect is improved through a coating process;

the thickness of the coating in the step 4) is 48-53 mu m respectively.

The invention also provides application of the double-coating diaphragm of the lithium-selenium disulfide battery, which is applied to the diaphragm of the lithium-selenium disulfide battery and is also applied to the diaphragm of the lithium-sulfur battery.

The COFs material can synthesize two-dimensional (2D) COFs and three-dimensional (3D) COFs based on building units with different geometric configurations, wherein the two-dimensional COFs is a layered framework material formed by stacking two-dimensional extension planes through pi-pi between planar molecules, and because electron clouds between layers in the COFs structure are mutually overlapped, the COFs material has a conductive foundation, and more importantly, a large number of one-dimensional nanopores are formed through stacking between the layers, so that a good place is provided for dispersion and storage of chalcogen.

The invention has the following beneficial effects:

the compounds of the invention containing a covalent organic framework and TiO2The double-coating diaphragm has excellent electrochemical performance, and the surface loading capacity of the diaphragm is 2mg/cm2In a lithium-selenium sulphide cell, by TiO2The chemical adsorption effect of the compound can effectively inhibit the generation of shuttle effect and the protection effect of covalent organic framework on the lithium negative electrode, thereby avoiding the generation of lithium dendrite, further improving the cycle stability of the battery and the specific capacity of the battery, and having excellent reversible performance.

Detailed Description

The present invention is described in further detail in the following description of specific embodiments and the accompanying drawings, it is to be understood that these embodiments are merely illustrative of the present invention and are not intended to limit the scope of the invention, which is defined by the appended claims, and modifications thereof by those skilled in the art after reading this disclosure that are equivalent to the above described embodiments.

All the raw materials and reagents of the invention are conventional market raw materials and reagents unless otherwise specified.

Example 1

A preparation method of a double-coating diaphragm applied to a lithium-selenium disulfide battery comprises the following steps:

1) preparation of raw materials of slurry a: taking 1,3,6, 8-tetra (4-formaldehyde phenyl) perylene and p-phenylenediamine with the molar ratio of 1:2, adding 4mL of 1, 4-dioxane, then adding 3mol/L of acetic acid solution, wherein the adding amount is 5% of the total volume of the organic solvent, then introducing argon gas and sealing, placing the mixed solution in a 120 ℃ oven for reaction for 72 hours, and then respectively washing with 1, 4-dioxane, tetrahydrofuran and acetone to obtain yellow powder PA-COF which is a raw material of a coating A;

2) preparation of slurry A: fully mixing the PA-COF prepared in the step 1) and the LA132 aqueous binder according to the proportion of 5:1, then dropwise adding 2mL of n-propanol aqueous solution, and uniformly mixing to obtain slurry A;

3) preparation of slurry B: taking industrial grade TiO2The powder being in accordance with TiO2Fully mixing the conductive carbon black and the water-based binder according to the mass ratio of 6:3:1, and then dropwise adding 2ml of n-propanol aqueous solution to obtain slurry B;

4) preparing a double-coating diaphragm: coating the slurry A and the slurry B on two sides of a PP (polypropylene) diaphragm respectively, wherein the coating thickness is 50 mu m, drying in a vacuum drying oven at 55 ℃, drying, and cutting into wafers to obtain the double-coating diaphragm.

Example 2

A preparation method of a double-coating diaphragm applied to a lithium-selenium disulfide battery comprises the following steps:

1) preparation of raw materials of slurry a: taking 1,3,6, 8-tetra (4-formaldehyde phenyl) perylene and p-phenylenediamine with the molar ratio of 1:2, adding 4mL of 1, 4-dioxane, then adding 3mol/L of acetic acid solution, wherein the adding amount is 5% of the total volume of the organic solvent, then introducing argon gas and sealing, placing the mixed solution in a 120 ℃ oven for reaction for 72 hours, and then respectively washing with 1, 4-dioxane, tetrahydrofuran and acetone to obtain yellow powder PA-COF which is a raw material of a coating A;

2) preparation of slurry A: fully mixing the PA-COF prepared in the step 1) and the LA132 aqueous binder according to the proportion of 5:1, then dropwise adding 2mL of n-propanol aqueous solution, and uniformly mixing to obtain slurry A;

3) preparation of slurry B: taking industrial grade TiO2The powder being in accordance with TiO2Fully mixing the conductive carbon black and the water-based binder according to the mass ratio of 6:3:1, and then dropwise adding 2ml of n-propanol aqueous solution to obtain slurry B;

4) preparing a double-coating diaphragm: coating the slurry A and the slurry B on two sides of a PE (polyethylene) diaphragm respectively, wherein the coating thickness is 50 micrometers, drying in a vacuum drying oven at 55 ℃, drying, and cutting into wafers to obtain the double-coating diaphragm.

Example 3

A preparation method of a double-coating diaphragm applied to a lithium-selenium disulfide battery comprises the following steps:

1) preparation of raw materials of slurry a: taking 1,3,6, 8-tetra (4-formaldehyde phenyl) perylene and p-phenylenediamine with the molar ratio of 1:2, adding 4mL of 1, 4-dioxane, then adding 3mol/L of acetic acid solution, wherein the adding amount is 50% of the total volume of the organic solvent, then introducing argon gas and sealing, placing the mixed solution in a 120 ℃ oven for reaction for 72 hours, and then respectively washing with 1, 4-dioxane, tetrahydrofuran and acetone to obtain yellow powder PA-COF which is a raw material of a coating A;

2) preparation of slurry A: fully mixing the PA-COF prepared in the step 1) and the LA132 aqueous binder according to the ratio of 3:1, then dropwise adding 2mL of n-propanol aqueous solution, and uniformly mixing to obtain slurry A;

3) preparation of slurry B: taking industrial grade TiO2The powder being in accordance with TiO2Fully mixing the conductive carbon black and the water-based binder according to the mass ratio of 6:3:1, and then dropwise adding 2ml of n-propanol aqueous solution to obtain slurry B;

4) preparing a double-coating diaphragm: coating the slurry A and the slurry B on two sides of a PP (polypropylene) diaphragm respectively, wherein the coating thickness is 50 mu m, drying in a vacuum drying oven at 55 ℃, drying, and cutting into wafers to obtain the double-coating diaphragm.

The voltage range tested was 1.7-2.7V, and CHI660C electrochemical workstation measured as Cyclic Voltammetry (CV) with a CV curve recorded at a scan rate of 0.1mV/s, with the test results shown in FIG. 4.

Fig. 3 is a schematic diagram of the cycle of the double-coated separator applied to the new lithium-selenium disulfide battery for 200 cycles at a current density of 0.5C (1C =1124 mAh/g), and it can be seen from the diagram that the capacity of the first cycle is 969.1mAh/g, the capacity is maintained at 775.9mAh/g after 200 cycles, the coulombic efficiency in the whole cycle process is close to 100%, which indicates that the battery has excellent reversibility.

FIGS. 4 and 5 are the charge-discharge curve and cyclic voltammetry curve of the double-coating diaphragm applied to the novel lithium-selenium disulfide battery, and it can be seen from FIG. 4 that three discharge platforms appear at 2.35V, 2.23V and 2.05V respectively during discharge, and SeS corresponds to 2.35V and 2.23V2The process of converting into lithium polysulfide and lithium selenide corresponds to the process of converting lithium polysulfide and lithium selenide into lithium sulfide and lithium selenide at 2.05V, and the phenomenon corresponds to the cyclic voltammetry of fig. 5, and it can be seen from fig. 5 that the electrochemical performance of the double-coating diaphragm applied to the novel lithium-selenium disulfide battery is relatively stable.

Fig. 6 is a schematic diagram of the double-coating separator of the present invention applied to a new lithium-selenium disulfide battery for 800 cycles at a current density of 1C, and it can be seen from the diagram that the specific discharge capacity of the first cycle is 722.9 mAh/g, and the capacity of the first cycle is still maintained at about 400 mAh/g after 800 cycles, which shows that the stability is relatively excellent.
